test_name: Off-key mark and test-id coexistence on the same NoteHead (callback chaining)
description: Regression test for Known Issue #1: the procedure model's off-key-mark ('dot) and cnb/test-ids.ly are both active. The F#4 in C major must carry BOTH modules' effects on the same NoteHead grob: the test-id tag (element id + data-* attributes prove test-ids ran) and the off-key dot stencil (a taller bounding box than in-key noteheads proves the mark's after-line-breaking callback ran). Before the chaining fix, a bare ly:grob-set-property! on after-line-breaking let one module silently clobber the other's hook. Measure 2 exercises the other three chained hooks (Beam/Tie/Slur in test-ids.ly). Migrated from the vector-model off-key indicator to the procedure model in set 007 (this test absorbed the coverage of the former off-key-coexistence-procedure.json, which was retired as a strict subset). NOTE: the tie is asserted by count, not id — cnb:spanner-left-note-attrs cannot resolve a Tie's left-bound NoteHead (a Tie's spanner bound IS the NoteHead, not a NoteColumn), a pre-existing limitation that yields a 'ti-?-...' id.

assertions.description: All 10 noteheads present and tagged by test-ids

assertions._comment: === SECTION 2: THE OFF-KEY NOTE CARRIES BOTH EFFECTS ===

assertions.description: F#4 notehead: test-id tag present (id resolves, data-* correct)
F#4 notehead: off-key dot present (bbox taller than in-key C4)

assertions._comment: === SECTION 3: BEAM/TIE/SLUR CHAINED HOOKS ALL FIRED ===

assertions.description: Beam hook fired: beamed eighths in measure 2 tagged via chained callback
Slur hook fired: slur starting on C5 tagged via chained callback
Tie hook fired: exactly one tagged tie element in the SVG

assertions._comment: === SECTION 4: IN-KEY NOTES ARE NOT MARKED ===

assertions.description: C4 (in key): no off-key mark, bbox is plain notehead height
